scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --filter backend start:dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.init:project: cp -n apps/backend/.env.example apps/backend/.env 2>/dev/null; cp -n apps/frontend/.env.example apps/frontend/.env 2>/dev/null; pnpm install && docker compose up -d && pnpm --filter backend migration:run:dev && pnpm --filter backend seed
scripts.db:start: docker compose up -d && pnpm --filter backend migration:run:dev
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down && docker compose up -d
